title: China Says US, Chinese and Russian Leaders to Hold First Trilateral Meeting at APEC
summary: China’s Foreign Ministry said the US, Chinese and Russian leaders plan to meet on November 19 on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, in what media described as their first dedicated trilateral meeting. The meeting is not part of APEC’s official agenda, and no agenda or expected outcomes were announced.
